title: Solidity Pro VS Code Extensions Steal Crypto Wallets, API Keys, and Credentials
summary: Cybersecurity researchers have flagged a malicious Microsoft Visual Studio Code (VS Code) extension named Solidity Pro ("solidity-pro") that has been observed delivering a browser wallet and credential stealer.
card_summary: Cybersecurity researchers have flagged a malicious Microsoft Visual Studio Code (VS Code) extension named Solidity Pro ("solidity-pro") that has been observed delivering a browser wallet and credential stealer.
email_summary:
Cybersecurity researchers have flagged a malicious Microsoft Visual Studio Code (VS Code) extension named Solidity Pro ("solidity-pro") that has been observed delivering a browser wallet and credential stealer. The names of the extensions are below -

 helper-beeps.solidity-pro
 web3devtoolsx.solidity-pro

Although neither of the extensions is now available on Open VSX, the GitHub repository.

title: OpenAI's Next AI Model Astra Shows Cyber Performance Strong Enough to Trigger Pause
summary: OpenAI has announced that it's pausing some "internal activities" involving its upcoming artificial intelligence (AI) model Astra after an internal evaluation found it had made significant advancements in agentic coding and cybersecurity.
